protocol.extends: EVAL-71 (identical skew surface signal via build_surface_bars, 900s window) + EVAL-103 (single-asset skew signal path verbatim) + EVAL-65 (permutation / bootstrap inference) + EVAL-62 (FDR / seed / zwindow); distinct cell: single-asset skew -> forward CVaR (expected shortfall) of signed return
protocol.supersedes: nothing -- completes the 4-signal surface->CVaR sweep (term_slope EVAL-161, term_ratio EVAL-162, atm_iv EVAL-163, skew EVAL-164); complements EVAL-103 (skew -> signed return mean) with a tail-risk target (CVaR); no traded-form claim
protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-ATM implied-vol surface SKEW from the real Deribit option trade tape: skew = mean put iv minus mean call iv of near-ATM trades (|strike/spot-1|<=atm_band) over the trailing 900s window, forward-filled then expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward CVaR (expected shortfall) of signed log-returns = mean of the worst CVAR_ALPHA-tail of the next H perp log returns, strictly after the decision at bar k
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(skew_z_k, cvar_forward_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (higher near-ATM skew -> higher forward expected shortfall)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
